title: SARL: Label-Free Reinforcement Learning by Rewarding Reasoning Topology
abstract: arXiv:2603.27977v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement learning is critical to improving large reasoning models, but its success relies heavily on verifiable rewards (RLVR), making it hard to use in open-ended domains where correctness is ambiguous and cannot be verified. Moreover, reasoning trajectories remain largely unconstrained, and optimizing solely toward the final answer can favor early exploitation over generalization. In this work, we ask whether general reasoning ability can be improved by teaching models how to think (the structure of reasoning) rather than what to produce (the outcome of reasoning), and we extend traditional RLVR to open-ended settings. We introduce Structure-Aware Reinforcement Learning (SARL), a label-free framework that constructs per-response reasoning maps from intermediate thinking steps and rewards their reasoning topology. SARL shifts supervision from destination to path, encouraging reasoning trajectories that are both locally coherent

translated_title: SARL：通过奖励推理拓扑实现的无标签强化学习
translated_abstract: 强化学习对于提升大型推理模型至关重要，但其成功高度依赖可验证奖励，这使得它难以应用于正确性模糊且无法验证的开放式领域。此外，推理轨迹在很大程度上仍不受约束，仅针对最终答案进行优化可能导致过早利用而非泛化。在这项工作中，我们探讨是否可以通过教模型“如何思考”（推理的结构）而非“产出什么”（推理的结果）来提升通用推理能力，并将传统的可验证奖励强化学习扩展到开放式设置。我们提出了结构感知强化学习，这是一个无标签框架，它从中间思考步骤构建针对每个响应的推理图，并对其推理拓扑进行奖励。SARL 将监督从“目的地”转移到“路径”，鼓励既局部连贯……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SARL 是一种无标签强化学习框架，通过从中间思考步骤构建推理图并奖励其推理拓扑，将监督从最终答案转向推理路径本身，从而把强化学习扩展到正确性难以验证的开放式领域。
en_tdlr: SARL is a label-free reinforcement learning framework that constructs per-response reasoning maps from intermediate thinking steps and rewards their reasoning topology, shifting supervision from the final answer to the reasoning path and extending RL to open-ended domains where correctness cannot be verified.
